My children! let us love not in word or with the tongue, but in deed and in truth, 1 John 3:17–18.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).
Chrysostom's «хищение» (khishchenie, 'plunder') and «лихоимство» (likhoimstvo, 'extortion') are kept distinct; the source's numerals (3, 15, 7) are kept; «странник» (strannik) is 'wanderer'.
